hero.title: Shri Guru Ram Rai University
hero.summary: Shri Guru Ram Rai University’s School of Agricultural Sciences offers a four-year agriculture degree in Dehradun. The school describes research farms, protected cultivation and enterprise units, with teaching departments covering crops, soils, horticulture, plant health and seed science.

overview.heading: Agricultural study across production and plant-health disciplines
paragraphs: SGRRU places agriculture in a dedicated constituent school. Its departmental list includes agronomy, horticulture, seed science, soil science, entomology, plant pathology, genetics and plant breeding, and food technology. For an undergraduate applicant, this shows the range of scientific subjects surrounding the agriculture degree rather than a single crop specialism.

The B.Sc. course page describes an eight-semester programme with laboratory and farm learning. Its eligibility text accepts specified science, agriculture or horticulture backgrounds. A 2025 prospectus names an entrance examination, whereas the current webpage only says admission follows university norms. Applicants should request the rule for their intended intake rather than assuming that an older route is unchanged.

admissions.intro: Use the university’s official admission enquiry route for a current course notice. The 2025 prospectus and undated B.Sc. page give useful academic information, but a confirmed 2026-27 entrance and counselling schedule was not verified.

campus.heading: Protected cultivation and enterprise units
campus.intro: The course page names a polyhouse, weather station, apiary, mushroom unit, nursery, orchard, vermicompost unit and biogas plant. The school page gives conflicting farm-area figures, so no acreage is presented as settled.

faqs.question: How long is SGRRU’s agriculture degree?
faqs.answer: The official programme page gives four years and eight semesters.

faqs.question: What practical enterprise units are named?

faqs.answer: The row explicitly names B.Sc. (Hons.) Agriculture; the verified postgraduate offerings are not added to that accreditation scope.

faqs.question: Who is named as the agriculture dean?
